text: Andhra Pradesh Poultry Development Policy 2026-2029, environment-controlled sheds. Interest subsidy up to 5% on term loans for up to two years from commercial operations, limited to Rs.5 lakh. subject: National Livestock Mission rural poultry capital subsidy in Andhra Pradesh
text: Andhra Pradesh Poultry Development Policy 2026-2029, citing the National Livestock Mission. For a rural poultry parent farm, rural hatchery or brooder cum mother unit, the central government gives 50% capital subsidy up to Rs.25 lakh. Individuals, SHGs, FPOs, farmers' cooperatives or JLGs and section 8 companies are eligible.
